how_to_apply: The online application link is available on North Eastern Railway's website, www.ner.indianrailways.gov.in. The notification gives no separate direct link, so candidates should apply through the website.
Visit the official website www.ner.indianrailways.gov.in and open the online application link.
Carefully read all the instructions before filling the online application form.
Fill in the form following the step-by-step procedure given on the webpage, completing all required fields carefully.
Upload a scanned recent coloured photograph, signature and all relevant marksheets/certificates at the prescribed place.
Deposit the requisite examination fee as per the instructions on the web page.
After depositing the fee, log in again and take a printout of the application form for future reference.
Candidates applying for both Level-2 and Level-1 posts must submit separate applications with separate fees.
important_instructions: Candidates should ensure they fulfil all eligibility norms before applying. Qualifications/certificates acquired after the last date of application will not be considered. A candidate will be called for the written examination only if considered to fulfil all eligibility criteria as per the application. Candidature remains provisional until certificates are examined at document verification. Verification of all documents/certificates is mandatory for appointment. Original documents/certificates must be produced at document verification. No additional time will be given, and candidature of such candidates is liable to be forfeited. Candidates giving false information or suppressing facts will be disqualified, their candidature cancelled at any stage, and they are liable to debarment and legal action. Candidates attempting fraud/impersonation are liable to be debarred from future Railway recruitment examinations. Candidates found eligible for appointment must pass the prescribed medical examination conducted by the Railway administration. Mere selection and recommendation for appointment does not confer any right to recruitment/appointment in Railway. A Second class free journey pass from the nearest Railway station mentioned in the application form will be issued to SC and ST candidates whenever they are called at any stage of recruitment. Persons appointed against the Scouts & Guides Quota to the category of clerks must acquire the prescribed typing proficiency within two years from the date of appointment. Their appointment will be provisional subject to this, and no additional time will be given; services of those who fail will be summarily terminated. In case of difference between the English and Hindi versions of the Employment Notice, the English version is applicable. The decision of RRC/NER on eligibility, acceptance or rejection of applications, issue of free journey pass, penalty for false information, mode of selection, conduct of examinations, allotment of examination centre and all other recruitment matters is final and binding. No enquiry or correspondence will be entertained. Any legal issues fall within the jurisdiction of the Central Administrative Tribunal, Allahabad. Candidates should visit www.ner.indianrailways.gov.in regularly for information and updates.

Annexure – A: Format of Certificate of Activeness (to be certified by the Group Leader, District Organising Commissioner and District Commissioner, with name, date and rubber stamp). Annexure – I: Declaration proforma for waiver of examination fee by Minority candidates, to be submitted at document verification. Such candidates must furnish a Minority Community Declaration affidavit on Non-Judicial Stamp paper stating that they belong to a minority community notified by the Central Government (Muslim / Sikh / Christian / Buddhist / Jain / Zoroastrians (Parsis)). Annexure – II: Income Certificate proforma for waiver of examination fee by Economically Backward Class (EBC) candidates, to be submitted at document verification. EBC means candidates whose family income is less than ₹50,000 per annum. The certificate may be issued by: (1) District Magistrate or any other Revenue Officer up to the level of Tahsildar; (2) Sitting Member of Parliament of Lok Sabha for persons of their own Constituency; (3) Sitting Member of Parliament of Rajya Sabha for persons of the district in which the MP normally resides; (4) Union Minister for any person from anywhere in the country.

content_sections.heading: NER Scouts & Guides Quota Recruitment 2026 – Quick Summary
content_sections.text: Who is recruiting? Railway Recruitment Cell, North Eastern Railway (NER), Gorakhpur. Which posts? Group 'C' posts in Level-2 (Grade Pay-1900) and erstwhile Group 'D' posts in Level-1 (Grade Pay-1800). Individual post names are not specified in the notification. How many vacancies? 3 posts at Level-2 and 8 posts at Level-1, i.e. 11 posts in total (total calculated from the unit-wise table in the notification; the notification does not state a combined total). Who can apply? Eligible Indian citizens who meet the educational and Scouting-Guiding qualifications and the age limit. Application start date: 07.10.2026, 11:00 hrs. Last date: 06.11.2026, 18:00 hrs. Application mode: Online, through the link on www.ner.indianrailways.gov.in. Job location: North Eastern Railway, BLW/Varanasi, and the Izzatnagar, Lucknow and Varanasi Divisions of NER.

content_sections.heading: NER Scouts & Guides Quota Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must fulfil both the educational qualification for the level they are applying for and the Scouting-Guiding qualifications. Candidates must ensure that they meet all eligibility norms before applying. President Scout/Guide/Rover/Ranger or Himalayan Wood Badge (HWB) holder in any section. However, their empanelment/appointment will be regulated as per the procedure laid down in Para l(iii) of the Board's instructions dated 07.02.2000.

The 50% aggregate requirement will not be insisted upon for SC, ST, Persons with Benchmark Disability (PwBD) and Ex-Servicemen candidates, and candidates possessing a qualification higher than 12th; OR Matriculation (10th Pass)/SSLC plus ITI in relevant trade (recognised by NCVT/SCVT); OR Matriculation (10th Pass)/SSLC plus Course Completed Act Apprenticeship in relevant trade.
Matriculation (10th pass) OR ITI or its equivalent OR National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) granted by NCVT.

content_sections.text: Candidates found eligible will be assessed on the basis of a written examination (60 marks) and marks on certificates (40 marks), for a total of 100 marks. Candidates found eligible for appointment must also pass the prescribed medical examination conducted by the Railway administration. Separate Computer Based Tests (CBT) will be conducted for Level-2 (Group 'C') and Level-1 (erstwhile Group 'D') posts. The paper consists of 40 objective type questions (40 marks) and 01 essay type question (20 marks) relating to the Scouts and Guides organization and its activities and General Knowledge, as per the syllabus. 01 mark is awarded for each correct answer and 1/3 mark is deducted for every incorrect answer. There is no negative marking for the essay type question. The minimum qualifying marks in the written examination for all candidates are 40%. Based on written examination performance, candidates equal to 5 times the number of vacancies will be called for Document Verification, separately for Level-2 and Level-1 posts. Empanelment will be made in order of merit, prepared according to the overall marks obtained in the Written Examination and Marks on Certificates. faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by North Eastern Railway (RRC NER) for filling up vacancies against the Scouts & Guides Quota for the year 2026-27.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available in RRC NER Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 11 vacancies available, which include Group C (Level-2) and Group D (Level-1) posts.

faq.question: Q3. What are the important dates for online application?
faq.answer: The online application starts on 7 October 2026 and the last date to submit applications online is 6 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum educational qualification required for Level-2 posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must be 12th pass with 50% marks, or possess a Matriculation plus ITI / Course Completed Act Apprenticeship along with specific Scouting and Guiding credentials.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Level-1 posts?
faq.answer: The age limit for Level-1 posts is between 18 to 33 years as on 01-01-2027, with upper age relaxations applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for general candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for all other candidates excluding reserved and economically backward classes is Rs. 500.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for SC/ST and women candidates?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates belonging to SC, ST, Ex-Servicemen, PwBD, Women, Minorities, and Economically Backward Classes are required to pay a reduced fee of Rs. 250.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online by visiting the official website of North Eastern Railway at www.ner.indianrailways.gov.in.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for RRC NER Scouts & Guides Quota recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises a Written Examination (Computer Based Test), evaluation of marks based on certificates, and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I download the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: You can download the official notification PDF by clicking the direct link provided in the Important Links section of this article.
